name: Faq
description: Collapsible questions and answers in single-column, two-column, grouped, or bordered XL layouts. The two-column variant includes a contact card for unanswered questions.
when_to_use: Lower page regions to resolve objections and support questions. Use grouped when questions span multiple topics; use two-col when a contact escalation path should be visible.
capabilities: accordion behavior (one open item at a time)
four layouts: single (centered), two-col (intro left, FAQ right), grouped by category, bordered XL (cream)
contact card with mail + button (two-col variant)
category grouping via a free-text group label per question

variants.description: Intro text and contact card left, accordion right. Uses contact_label, contact_mail, contact_button.
Questions clustered under their items[].group headings.
Bordered XL rows with large regular-weight questions on a cream background.

breakpoints.mobile: Single column everywhere; contact card stacks above the accordion.
breakpoints.desktop: Two-column split for the two-col variant.

ai.prompt_summary: Faq: accordion Q&A. Settings: variant (single|two-col|grouped|bordered). Fields: eyebrow, headline, intro; two-col only: contact_label, contact_mail, contact_button; items[] (min 1): { q, a, group (grouped variant only) }.
ai.content_guidelines: 5-8 questions. Questions phrased from the visitor's perspective, answers 1-3 sentences. Group labels short nouns (e.g. Preise, Ablauf).

field_hints.items.group: Only rendered by the grouped variant; items sharing a label appear under that heading.
